_comment: The parameter catalog (spec 12.2). The order is the wire index: append only. Every min/max carries a range_why; a range marked 'proposed' is the GCS side's draft and needs the firmware owner's confirmation. See catalog.py for the rules.

1.name: RATE_ROLL
1.doc: Roll rate PID gains. Set together: a half-written set of gains is never live.

4.name: ANGLE
4.doc: Angle-loop proportional gains of the three axes.

5.name: NOTCH
5.doc: Dynamic gyro notch: enable and detection settings. fmin must stay below fmax, so they commit together.

6.name: MOTGEO
6.doc: Motor geometry of the 4-motor mixer: position and spin of every motor. A mixer built from half a geometry would be wrong, so the 12 fields commit together.

params.doc: CRC-32 of this catalog's id, type, flags, group, min and max (generated). The GCS reads it first: a different value means the GCS catalog is not the one this firmware runs, and the GCS then shows the raw values read-only.
params.range_why: A checksum: every 32-bit value is possible.

params.doc: Roll rate PID proportional gain (normalised output per deg/s).
params.range_why: proposed 0.00075..1: the survey's range for Kp; the compiled gains are about 0.003, so 1.0 is more than 300x above them. The minimum is 0.25x the compiled value so that one write cannot turn the loop off.

params.doc: Roll rate PID integral gain.
params.range_why: proposed 0..1: the survey's range for Ki; compiled gains are about 0.003 to 0.008.

params.doc: Roll rate PID derivative gain.
params.range_why: proposed 0..0.01: the survey's range for Kd; the compiled value is 0.00005 (0 for yaw).

params.doc: Roll rate PID feed-forward gain.
params.range_why: proposed 0..1: the survey's range for Kff; compiled value 0 (off).

params.doc: Roll angle-loop proportional gain (deg/s of rate command per degree of error).
params.range_why: proposed 0.75..20: the survey's range; compiled values are 3.0 (roll, pitch) and 1.2 (yaw). The minimum is 0.25x the compiled value so that one write cannot turn the loop off.

params.doc: Roll gyro low-pass time constant; 0 turns the filter off.
params.range_why: proposed 0..0.01 s (16 Hz cutoff at the top): a longer time constant on the rate-loop gyro adds phase lag below the control bandwidth and the loop oscillates; the compiled default is off (0).

params.doc: Pitch gyro low-pass time constant; 0 turns the filter off.

params.doc: Roll rate PID derivative-term low-pass time constant; 0 turns the filter off.
params.range_why: proposed 0..0.5 s: the survey says 0..0.1 s, but the compiled yaw value is 0.3 s (noted there as unusually large), and the catalog default must equal the compiled value, so the upper bound is 0.5 s.

params.doc: Dynamic gyro notch master enable (0 off, 1 on).
params.range_why: 0 or 1: a switch.

params.doc: Notch band-stop Q (higher is narrower).
params.range_why: proposed 1..20: the survey's range; compiled default 8.

params.doc: Lower bound of the notch detection band.
params.range_why: proposed 20..500 Hz: below 20 Hz is control bandwidth, above 500 Hz is the analyser's Nyquist limit (1 kHz inner loop); compiled default 60 Hz.

params.doc: Upper bound of the notch detection band; must stay above NOTCH_FMIN (checked when the group commits).
params.range_why: proposed 20..500 Hz, as NOTCH_FMIN; compiled default 450 Hz.

params.doc: Minimum peak-to-mean power ratio for a spectral peak to count as a notch target.
params.range_why: proposed 1..20: a ratio below 1 would accept noise as a peak; compiled default 4.

params.doc: Motor 1 position, forward (m). Today's mixer uses only the sign.
params.range_why: proposed -10..10 m: larger than any airframe this firmware flies (the survey notes a 15 inch frame); the default is the X-quad sign pattern, magnitude 1.

params.doc: Motor 1 spin direction: +1 counter-clockwise seen from above, -1 clockwise. 0 is refused when the group commits.
params.range_why: -1..1: the two directions; 0 sits inside the type range but is not a direction, so the group commit refuses it.
